interpretation.t0_snapshot_scope: scope actually held/expressed around May 2010, with contemporaneous achievements included only where they define active professional scope
interpretation.baseline_peak_through_t0: highest verified scope reached on or before selection
interpretation.important_distinction: baseline peak is not post-T0 peak and cannot yet be used alone to calculate final Type-A prediction accuracy

versioning_rule: Do not silently edit frozen v1.0. New evidence requires a superseding v1.1 or later freeze with explicit change log.
next_gate: Build and audit post_t0_peak for all 100, then calculate true baseline-adjusted advancement and Type-A selection precision.
